body.p: . Completes 's collations in src/collation.c (src/collation_internal.h), used through one resolver.

item.p: Four collations: codepoint, HTML ASCII case-insensitive, and also the Unicode case-insensitive collation (F&O 4.0, section 5.2.5, which every processor must recognize; predates it), and UCA URIs with fallback. fallback=no, and a fallback value other than yes/no, is not supported (FOCH0002); unknown keywords and values are ignored, the last value of a keyword wins, maxVariable, caseFirst and caseLevel also in their max-variable spellings.

UCA fallback (glossary ): every codepoint's full compatibility decomposition gives collation elements: a base character primary = its lower-case codepoint + 1 (codepoint order without case), secondary common, tertiary 1/2 for lower/upper (swapped by caseFirst= upper) + 2 for a compatibility variant; a combining mark (combining class > 0) only secondary = 2 + codepoint. Variable characters (whitespace, then P, Sm/Sk/So, Sc up to maxVariable) are shifted to a quaternary weight or blanked. Levels: primary, secondary (backwards reverses it), case (caseLevel), tertiary, quaternary (shifted only), identical (codepoints). lang, version, normalization, numeric and reorder are ignored. QT4 fn-collation, misc-UCACollation and fn-compare pass with it; the tables of advanced-uca-fallback stay out ().

Keys and matching: a key lists each compared level's nonzero weights in three bytes, levels separated by three zero bytes, so keys compare as bytes (fn:collation-key returns them as xs:base64Binary) and strings compare by keys. Substring matching (contains, starts-with, ends-with, substring-before/-after/-before-last/-after-last) compares collation units and accepts matches at codepoint boundaries only; the codepoint collation stays a byte search. distinct-values, duplicate-values, all-equal and all-different hash collation keys.

One resolver (sxml_function_library_find_collation / _resolve_collation, src/function_library.c): empty is the default collation, which is the codepoint collation until the static context's default_collation_uri and collation_bindings reach the evaluator (Proposed); a relative URI resolves against the static base URI (none: FOCH0002); FOCH0002 only for URIs sxml does not support. Bodies outside the string, sequence and deep-equal parts keep sxml_function_library_check_collation, which now also raises FOCH0002 for supported collations other than codepoint (Proposed: sxml_function_library_compare_collated).

sxml_collation_is_supported () is defined in src/collation.c, not src/xpath.c: the lookup lives there and 2.12 has not run; 2.12 must not define it again. The QT4 driver's collation check calls it; its dependency table now also lists unicode-normalization-form FULLY-NORMALIZED (accepting 2.4's proposal).

fn:deep-equal 4.0 (src/function_library_deep_equal.c): every option. A resumable body () for items-equal (asked before each item pair, attributes and single text nodes included; a leaf entry stays for array:index-of). "ordered": false and unordered-elements are unordered cursors on the explicit stack: each unit tries the unmatched candidates, a difference inside a trial truncates the stack to the cursor and tries the next (first fit). Function items: same item, or same body, arity, name and signature with deep-equal captured values; separately written inline functions are not compared for equivalence (Proposed). Without schemas typed-values and type-variety change nothing; debug writes nothing; options are coerced (a node or xs:untypedAtomic for a boolean).
